mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_question_answer (exam_id, question_id, question_type, student_id, course_id, score, annotation, student_answer) VALUES (#{examId}, #{questionId}, #{questionType}, #{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{score}, #{annotation}, #{studentAnswer})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM exam_question_answer WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
